## Engine reimplementations

- [**WoodyRE: reimplementing the Woody Woodpecker game engine**](https://github.com/jjmhalew/WoodyRE) - WoodyRE reimplements the engine of Woody Woodpecker: Escape from Buzz Buzzard Park, the 2001 PC game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/woodyre/)</sub>
- [**X-Settlers: reconstructing Settlers 3/4 maps and rendering**](https://github.com/skarmux/x-settlers) - X-Settlers is an early C++17 reimplementation effort for The Settlers 3/4 that renders map terrain and documents Settlers 3 map partitions. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/x-settlers-case/)</sub>
- [**xoreos: an open reimplementation of BioWare’s Aurora engine family**](https://github.com/xoreos/xoreos) - Reimplements BioWare’s Aurora engine and its later derivatives as a portable C++ engine that runs on the user’s installed game data, targeting nine games from Neverwinter Nights to Dragon Age II. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/xoreos-aurora-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**XU4: a reconstruction of Ultima IV**](https://github.com/xu4-engine/u4) - XU4 recreates Ultima IV for modern systems while loading the original DOS game's data at runtime. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/xu4-ultima-iv-case/)</sub>
- [**YodaStoriesNG: rebuilding Yoda Stories and Indiana Jones from their data files**](https://github.com/sp00nznet/YodaStoriesNG) - YodaStoriesNG reimplements Star Wars: Yoda Stories and Indiana Jones and His Desktop Adventures in C# and SDL2 using each game's original data file. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/yodastoriesng-case/)</sub>
- [**z2rs: an incremental Rust reconstruction of Zelda II checked against an emulator**](https://github.com/troyedwardsjr/z2rs) - Rebuilds Zelda II: The Adventure of Link (NES) in Rust for desktop, browser and Android by replacing the game’s 6502 routines one at a time. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/z2rs-zelda2-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**Zelda3: a C reimplementation of A Link to the Past**](https://github.com/snesrev/zelda3) - Zelda3 reimplements The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past in C, extracting levels and images from the user's US SNES ROM. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zelda3-case/)</sub>
- [**Zeliard: DOS engine analysis and an SDL2 source port**](https://github.com/awkto/zeliard-decomp) - Reconstructs Zeliard's DOS engine and resource handling as documented C code and an SDL2 port that reads the user's original game files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zeliard-dos-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**ZGloom: reimplementing the Amiga game Gloom**](https://github.com/Swizpig/ZGloom) - ZGloom reimplements the Amiga first-person game Gloom, including Zombie Massacre. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zgloom/)</sub>
- [**ZT1-Engine: reconstructing Zoo Tycoon 1 from zoo.exe**](https://github.com/AlexC1991/zt1-engine) - ZT1-Engine reimplements Zoo Tycoon 1 for modern Windows by recovering game rules from zoo.exe and comparing behavior with the original. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zt1-engine-case/)</sub>
